title: Gulf Beverages cut stockouts by 42% in 90 days. — Trackeys

hero.h1: Gulf Beverages cut stockouts by 42% in 90 days.
hero.p: Regional beverage distributor went from weekly stockout reports to live replenishment signals in under a quarter. The story — and the numbers.

sections.sub:
Gulf Beverages distributes 180 SKUs across 4,200 retail points in the UAE and Oman. Before Trackeys, stockouts averaged 11% — high enough to be a board-level topic. Ninety days after going live on Distribution + SFA, that number was 6.4%.
Three things, in order of impact: demand forecasting that recognized promotion lift per-SKU instead of per-category; van sales that logged secondary sales at point of sale; and an HOD dashboard that surfaced the worst-performing 2% of stores every morning for targeted intervention.
